newsitem.title: USA: General Motors Corp Q4 oper net falls.
newsitem.headline: General Motors Corp Q4 oper net falls.

text.p: Oper shr primary $0.92 $1.95
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 Q4 oper net includes extraordinary items resulting in net charges of $762 million, or $0.99 a share, including $700 million loss from labor strikes, $197 million gain from adjustments to plant closing reserve, $157 million loss on sale of four parts plants, $167 million charge for lump-sum payments to United Auto Workers union members, and $65 million gain from sale of preferred stock in Avis Inc.
1996 Q4 includes tax benefit of $262 million.

1995 Q4 includes extraordinary items resulting in net gain of $34 million, or $0.05 a share, including $249 million tax gain, temporary layoff charge of $114 million, and $101 million interest rate-related charge.
1995 Q4 excludes net income of $269 million from Electronic Data Systems Corp, which was spun off by GM in June 1996.
YEAR
Oper shr primary $6.07 $7.14
(All data above 000s except per share numbers)

NOTE: 1996 year oper net includes extraordinary items that reduced net income by $938 million, or $1.23 a share, including $1.2 billion unfavorable effect from strikes, $450 million gain from adjustment to plant closing reserve, $157 million loss from the sale of parts plants, $167 million charge from UAW lump sum payments, $65 million gain on Avis, and $72 million gain from the sale of 2.5 percent of DirecTV business.

1995 year oper net includes extraordinary items that increased net income by $183 million, or $0.05 a share, including items detailed in 1995 Q4 footnote above, plus gain of $163 million on sale of National Car Rental System Inc and charge of $14 million from preference share repurchase.
1995 year oper net excludes charge of $52 million, or $0.07 a share, from cumulative effect of accounting change.
Both years exclude discontinued income from Electronic Data Systems of $10 million vs $900 million.
Q4 net profit margin from continuing operations 2.2 percent versus 4.3 percent.
Q4 North American Operations loss $124 million vs profit $603 million.
Q4 International Operations net $353 million vs $498 million.
Q4 General Motors Acceptance Corp (GMAC) net $274 million vs $263 million.
Q4 worldwide vehicle deliveries 1,923,000 vs 2,019,000.
Q4 Hughes Electronics Corp net $281 million vs $295 million.
